blurb: Children ages 3-10 board the Sea Gypsy, a working pirate ship, and become official crew members with face painting and sailor vests. Activities include hoisting flags, blasting water cannons, and reading maps. The vessel is USCG inspected and captained by licensed, First Aid and CPR trained captains, with safety measures like lifejackets and mesh-lined railings.
extraNote: Captains are US Coast Guard licensed, trained in First Aid and CPR · Memorial Day through Labor Day
